name: install default is local-only
text: mammoth install default is local-only with zero signup; hosted sync via api key is the paid upgrade not the gate. Friction between install and the magic moment kills a stars-driven launch.

name: first agent integration is Claude Code
text: ship Claude Code first because the full stack already exists there (prime_* tools, cn CLI, cn prime setup, memory-using skills); fan out to Cursor/Cline/Windsurf later via shared MCP manifest snippets, not new code.

name: product name is mammoth
text: the ecosystem is named mammoth: same prehistoric register as caveman, evokes never-forgetting memory. Engines keep real names allsource-prime and chronis.

name: Core is the database
text: AllSource Core is a durable event store: WAL with CRC32 and fsync, Parquet with Snappy compression, DashMap in-memory reads. Event data survives restarts. Never describe Core as in-memory only.

name: Postgres is metadata only
text: PostgreSQL holds operational metadata only: users, tenants, API keys, billing. Events never go to Postgres. Scaling is via Core leader-follower replication, not another database.

name: auth terminates at Control Plane
text: all public authentication terminates at the Control Plane. Core is internal-only. SDKs and chronis point at the gateway, never directly at Core.

name: no amd64 cross-compile on Apple Silicon
text: building Docker images on Apple Silicon must be native arm64 only; QEMU cross-compilation to linux/amd64 fails on the Erlang NIF.

name: backend on Fly frontend on Vercel
text: the six backend apps deploy to Fly.io; the web frontend deploys to Vercel at www.all-source.xyz. There is no allsource-web Fly app. Never run fly deploy for anything under apps/web.

name: commit direct to main
text: this repo commits direct to main with no feature branches or pull requests for routine work. A branch-slip bug makes branching costly. Verify git branch before committing.

name: commit hook rejects AI attribution
text: the repo commit hook rejects Co-Authored-By trailers; use plain commit messages with no AI attribution.

name: benchmark credibility is numbers
text: caveman earned trust with a real token-savings table. mammoth must publish reproducible recall precision, cross-session win-rate, and tokens-saved numbers, and publish them honestly even if day-one recall is mediocre.

name: recall rides MCP not per-agent shims
text: memory is more portable than caveman because any MCP-capable agent speaks the prime_* tools natively. One server binary, one manifest stanza per agent, instead of bespoke per-agent installers.

name: embeddings are in-process via fastembed
text: allsource-prime computes embeddings in-process with fastembed using the AllMiniLML6V2 model, 384 dimensions, about 25MB, auto-downloaded on first call. No external embedding service is required.

name: licenses are mixed not all MIT
text: allsource-prime and allsource-core are Apache-2.0; chronis is MIT. Never claim the whole stack is MIT. The plugin and installer layer can be MIT.

name: auto-inject is the auto-activate engine
text: allsource-prime --auto-inject exposes a compressed knowledge index as the prime://auto-context MCP resource, injected into the agent system prompt every conversation. This is the equivalent of caveman's auto-trigger.

name: hosted tier is metered not free
text: the hosted cross-machine sync tier must be metered or paid from day one. A viral launch could flood Core with free users; do not open an unbounded free hosted tier.

name: chronis is event-sourced tasks
text: chronis is the cn CLI, an event-sourced task tracker where every action is an immutable event and state is derived from projections. It provides episodic work memory.

name: never store proprietary code in Prime
text: record only your own analysis, metadata, file paths, decisions and verdicts into Prime. Never put raw source code, secrets, or full file contents into nodes or embeddings unless the user explicitly allows it.

name: benchmark honesty rule
text: publish recall numbers honestly even when day-one quality is mediocre; show the improvement curve instead of hiding weak results, the same trust move caveman made with output-tokens-only

name: slash commands mirror auto-skill
text: ship /remember /recall /memory-status as explicit escape hatches alongside the auto-firing mammoth-memory skill, mirroring how caveman exposes /caveman next to its auto-trigger

name: installer needs no node
text: mammoth install.sh and install.ps1 are self-contained with no Node dependency, unlike caveman which delegates to a Node installer; mammoth only needs cargo plus python3 or ConvertTo-Json for the JSON merge

name: idempotent mcp upsert preserves servers
text: the installer upserts only the prime server into an agent mcp config and preserves any other MCP servers already configured, so re-running is safe

name: thirteen prime tools
text: allsource-prime exposes 13 MCP tools including prime_recall prime_context prime_add_node prime_embed prime_stats prime_index prime_neighbors prime_search prime_shortest_path prime_forget prime_history prime_similar prime_add_edge

name: prime_index orients first
text: prime_index returns a compressed token-counted markdown summary of everything the agent knows; call it first at conversation start to orient before searching for specifics

name: prime_context tiered recall
text: prime_context has tiered depth L0 stats-only L1 recent-conversation L2 full-hybrid-recall; default L2 adds the compressed index plus vectors plus graph expansion

name: recall is hybrid not vector-only
text: prime_recall fuses vector similarity with graph neighbor expansion and temporal recency; set depth 0 for vector-only or depth 1+ to include graph neighbors

name: HNSW via instant-distance
text: prime vector search uses an HNSW index implemented with the instant-distance crate for approximate nearest neighbor lookup over the 384-dim embeddings

name: chronis is TOON-optimized
text: chronis cn supports a --toon flag on any command emitting Token-Oriented Object Notation, pipe-delimited with no braces or quotes, about 50 percent fewer tokens than JSON for agent consumption

name: chronis priority enum
text: chronis cn task create priority must be p0 through p3 not bare integers, and task type must be one of task epic bug feature

name: chronis cold-parquet boot bug
text: chronis 0.7.1 read empty after a WAL reset because EmbeddedCore::open left Parquet cold; fixed in 0.7.2 by hydrating from Parquet on boot before projection backfill; no data was lost

name: immutable tags policy
text: never move or delete a git tag once created; if a release needs fixes bump the version instead of re-tagging

name: scoped release tags
text: SDK-only releases use sdk-<lang>-v<version> tags not whole-monorepo v<version>, so per-SDK versions do not collide with Core or Query Service versions

name: release discipline three gates
text: never tag a release until all three CI gates pass quality-rust quality-go and quality-elixir-full, and never push automatically; the user pushes manually

name: docker network name
text: the AllSource docker stack runs on the supabase_network_alpha-sigma-pro network defined in the wallet project docker-compose

name: core docker image registry
text: the Rust Core docker image is published to ghcr.io/all-source-os/chronos-core

name: core api v1 prefix
text: all Core endpoints use the /api/v1/ prefix; POST /api/v1/events returns 200 not 201; GET /api/v1/events/query returns events wrapped in an object with events and count

name: core query default order
text: Core events query results are ordered by timestamp then version ascending oldest-first by default; pass order=desc for newest-first to fetch the latest event for an entity

name: core throughput numbers
text: AllSource Core sustains about 469 thousand events per second ingest with about 12 microsecond reads from the DashMap in-memory index over the durable WAL plus Parquet store

name: clean env var names
text: use clean env var names like CORE_URL not RUST_CORE_URL; implementation details do not belong in env var names; the Elixir config key is :core_url

name: bun only for js
text: always use bun for JavaScript and TypeScript package management in this monorepo, never pnpm npm or yarn

name: oklch css variables
text: CSS variables use oklch format; reference them with var(--color-*) aliases not hsl(var(--*)) in inline styles and Recharts props

name: blog is mdx in content dir
text: the web blog renders MDX files from apps/web/content/ at the route /blog/[slug]; OG images are auto-generated via the /og route

name: compare page is 5-way
text: the /compare/agent-memory marketing page compares AllSource Prime against zer0dex Mem0 Letta and others on compressed index temporal queries provenance and recall accuracy

name: six fly apps
text: six backend apps deploy to Fly.io allsource-core allsource-query allsource-control-plane allsource-auth allsource-prime and allsource-registry; the web frontend deploys to Vercel

name: no allsource-web fly app
text: there is no allsource-web Fly app; it was destroyed after an accidental redeploy; never run fly deploy for anything under apps/web; frontend ships via git push to Vercel

name: admin emails allowlist
text: admin role is granted via an ADMIN_EMAILS allowlist at the Control Plane, not stored per-user in a database table

name: api key role string contract
text: API key role must be the string serviceaccount with no underscore fleet-wide; a UI drift to service_account silently 403d every minted key

name: five crates to cratesio
text: five Rust crates publish to crates.io including better-auth-allsource; the TypeScript Python and Go SDKs are GitHub-registry only not crates.io

name: gh cli token workaround
text: the gh CLI returns 401 unless commands are prefixed with env -u GITHUB_TOKEN to drop the conflicting token from the environment

name: no raft no multileader
text: Core scaling uses leader-follower replication via WAL shipping with writes to the leader and round-robin reads across followers; no Raft no multi-leader no PostgreSQL in the event path

name: postgres operational metadata only
text: PostgreSQL holds only operational metadata users tenants API keys and billing; event data lives exclusively in Core's WAL and Parquet store, never in Postgres

name: hosted tier is the upgrade
text: hosted cross-machine sync is a pull not a gate; users upgrade when local-only cannot solve their pain such as remembering across laptop and desktop or sharing memory with a team

name: magic moment definition
text: the mammoth magic moment is a fresh session recalling a decision made in an earlier session unprompted, making a neutral observer ask how did it know that

name: compose with caveman
text: mammoth positions complementary to caveman never competitive; caveman compresses the output, mammoth persists the context; an agent that does both is strictly better than either alone

name: auto-context resource uri
text: with --auto-inject the prime server exposes prime://auto-context as an MCP resource containing a compressed knowledge index injected into the agent system prompt each conversation

name: data dir env override
text: the prime data dir can be set with the --data-dir flag or the PRIME_DATA_DIR environment variable; default mode is mcp stdio, switch with --mode http

name: chronis migrate beads
text: chronis can import an existing .beads/issues.jsonl into chronis events with cn migrate-beads

name: core is internal only
text: Core is internal-only and never authenticates public callers; all public auth terminates at the Control Plane and SDKs and chronis point at the gateway not directly at Core

name: durability skill exists
text: the chronos-durability and chronos-embedded-durability skills write events restart and verify all survive, proving the WAL plus Parquet persistence guarantee

name: runner-up name recall rejected
text: the name recall was rejected as too generic SEO-hostile and tonally flat next to caveman; mammoth keeps the prehistoric register and evokes never-forgetting memory
